name: Trident Seafoods Wild Alaskan Salmon Burgers (Costco Frozen 12-Pack)
whyItWorks: Formed from 100% wild-caught Alaskan salmon with light seasoning and zero dairy or fillers. Rich in natural omega-3 fatty acids that dampen intestinal inflammation, serving as an easy burger alternative.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook directly from frozen on a lightly oiled skillet for 4-5 minutes per side. Serve on a plain white bun with light mayo or plain white rice.
